descriptions.en: [GetHyperthermiaIntroIfRedGiant]

descriptions.zh:
我们完成了第一座采集能量并转化为§Y结晶熵§!的基础设施。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成结晶熵。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

§H解锁巨型结构：§!§Y星系熔炉框架§!
descriptions.en:
We have completed our first working infrastructure for harvesting energy and converting it into §YCrystallized Entropy§!. These crystals hold immense thermal energy and already enable our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize Crystallized Entropy by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

§HUnlocks Megastructure:§! §YGalactic Crucible Frame§!

descriptions.zh:
现有的§Y结晶熵§!样本让我们在无需危及母星也能进行采集与合成。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成结晶熵。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

§H解锁巨型结构：§!§Y星系熔炉框架§!
descriptions.en:
With our existing samples of §YCrystallized Entropy§!, we can harvest and synthesize them without endangering our home star. These crystals hold immense thermal energy, allowing our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize Crystallized Entropy by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

§HUnlocks Megastructure:§! §YGalactic Crucible Frame§!

tooltips.zh: 派遣工程船围绕恒星建造§Y星系熔炉框架§!。
tooltips.en: Use a Construction Ship to build the §YGalactic Crucible Frame§! around a star.

label.en: Order the drones to begin construction.

tooltips.zh: 派遣工程船围绕恒星建造§Y星系熔炉框架§!。
tooltips.en: Use a Construction Ship to build the §YGalactic Crucible Frame§! around a star.

descriptions.zh: 我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
descriptions.en: We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future.

descriptions.zh:
星系熔炉底盘可部署§Y导管群§!可引导并强化恒星的熵能，一旦发送，它们就会回收并强化恒星的能量输出。使其演化为红巨星，从而将恒星系加热至支撑帝国扩张基础设施的水平。

此类§Y导管群§!能够定期生产并自主运作，目前仅限于我方领土，但未来有望扩展至整个星系，推动帝国持续增长。

§H可升级的巨型结构如下：§!§Y星系熔炉核心§!
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Crucible Chassis is now ready to deploy §YConduits§!: automated systems designed to channel and amplify stellar entropy. Once dispatched, they'll recycle and intensify a star's energy output, converting it into a Red Giant, heating entire systems to support our empire's expanding infrastructure.

These §YConduits§! can be produced at regular intervals and operate autonomously for our convenience. For now, they'll remain within our territory, but in time, it may serve us to let them spread across the galaxy. After all, our empire never stops growing.

§HMegastructure Upgrade Available:§! §YGalactic Crucible Core§!

options.script:
name = infernals.1010.a
trigger = { is_gestalt = no }

label.zh: 迫切需要征服更多恒星。
label.en: We need to conquer more stars.

options.script:
name = infernals.1010.b
trigger = { is_gestalt = yes }

descriptions.zh:
§Y结晶熵§!研究揭示惊天秘密：在高浓度下，该物质可被用于制造足以摧毁整颗行星的武器。若我方掌握此力量，整个星系或将归于我手。

但若追求军事应用，将破坏与邻邦脆弱信任。谁又能保证此武器不会反噬自身？

若望证我方意图，必须公然削弱星系熔炉核心，禁止生产此类武器。否则，终会有人将其用于杀戮，即我方或他人。

§H该抉择将解锁特殊项目§!。
descriptions.en:
Our continued research into §YCrystallized Entropy§! has unveiled a chilling possibility: when highly concentrated, they can power weapons of unimaginable scale, capable of devastating entire planets. With such power, the galaxy could fall under our mercy.

But exploring these military applications would shatter what little trust remains between us and our neighbors. And who's to say such weapons couldn't one day be turned against us?

Empty words of peace will not suffice. If we wish to prove our intentions, we must publicly cripple the Galactic Crucible Core, ensuring it can never produce such weaponry. Otherwise, it's only a matter of time before this technology is weaponized, by us, or by someone else.

§HThis decision unlocks a Special Project§!

tooltips.zh:
阻止接触危机等级§R灾难§!。

§H特殊项目立项：§!§Y意外关联§!将§Y星系熔炉核心§!转变为§Y星系熔炉研究院§!。
tooltips.en:
Prevents access to Crisis level §RCalamity§!. 

§HIssues Special Project:§! §YUnforeseen Correlation§! to turn the §YGalactic Crucible Core§! into a §YGalactic Crucible Institute§!.

descriptions.zh:
我方对§Y结晶熵§!及§Y策划火风暴项目§!之调查确认毁灭性武器潜力属实。掌握此等力量后，外交礼节将不再约束我们的行动。

由于其激进的军事化应用，星系熔炉枢纽扩张可以加速。武器越早解锁，我们越早称霸。

§H巨型结构升级可用：§!§Y星系熔炉§!
descriptions.en:
Our investigation into §YCrystallized Entropy§! and the §YDesigned Firestorm Project§! has confirmed what we suspected: the potential for devastating weaponry is real. With such power in our hands, we no longer need to temper ourselves for the sake of diplomatic niceties.

The Galactic Crucible Hub's expansion will accelerate, with special focus on its more... aggressive applications. The sooner we unlock these weapons, the less the galaxy's opinions will matter.

§HMegastructure Upgrade Available:§! §YGalactic Crucible§!

label.zh: 我们必须为战争做好准备。
label.en: We must ready ourselves for war.

tooltips.zh:
—§Y星系熔炉§!扩张应为优先事项。
—§Y导管群§!对敌方舰船和空间站造成被动伤害。
tooltips.en:
- The §YGalactic Crucible§! expansion should be a priority.
- §YConduits§! deal passive damage to hostile ships and stations.

label.zh: 我们的对手将成为火焰的引燃物。
label.en: Our rivals shall be kindling for the fire.

tooltips.zh:
—§Y星系熔炉§!扩张应为优先事项。
—§Y导管群§!对敌方舰船和空间站造成被动伤害。
tooltips.en:
- The §YGalactic Crucible§! expansion should be a priority.
- §YConduits§! deal passive damage to hostile ships and stations.

descriptions.zh:
星系熔炉枢纽已被成功削弱，确保其不再能被扩展或用于破坏性目的。虽然失去了其全部潜能令人遗憾，但继续那条道路将带来灾难风险及所有外交关系的崩溃。

幸运的是，即使功能受限，星系熔炉研究院仍将是强大且繁荣的能源来源。我们在越过界限前选择了退步，保障了与星海共同体合作的未来，同时依然从这项非凡科学中获益。

§H巨型结构升级可用：§!§Y星系熔炉研究院§!
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Crucible Hub has been successfully hobbled, ensuring it can no longer be expanded or repurposed for destructive ends. While the loss of its full potential is regrettable, continuing down that path would have risked catastrophe, and the collapse of all diplomatic ties.

Fortunately, even in its limited form, the Galactic Crucible Institute will remain a powerful source of energy and prosperity. We've stepped back before crossing a line, securing a future where we can collaborate with the galactic community while still benefiting from this remarkable science.

§HMegastructure Upgrade Available:§! §YGalactic Crucible Institute§!

trigger = { is_gestalt = no }

name = infernals.1021.b
trigger = { is_gestalt = yes }

descriptions.zh:
我们对§Y导管群§!的持续研究以及将恒星转化为红巨星的研究表明，我们或许能够扩大行动规模，直接使银河系核心过热，从而在整个银河触发热级联，把它改造成对我们更为适宜的环境。

我们已确定六个核心周边星系，可作为此计划的作业枢纽。这些星系位于星系超空间航路网络之外，但相关稳定虫洞的构建工作正紧锣密鼓进行。
descriptions.en:
Our ongoing research into §YConduits§! and transforming stars into Red Giants suggests we may be able to scale up our operations to overheat the Galactic Core itself, triggering a thermal cascade across the entire Galaxy, thus transforming it into a much more hospitable place for us.

We have identified six systems surrounding the core that could serve as operational hubs for this endeavor. These systems lie beyond the galactic hyperlane network, but efforts are underway to generate stable wormholes and establish access.

label.zh: 只有我们适合在烈焰中生存。
label.en: We are the only ones fit to survive the flames.

tooltips.zh: 其他物种将试图反对我们。准备星系战争。
tooltips.en: Other species will try to oppose us. Prepare for Galactic war.

label.zh: 整个星系将在熊熊烈焰中归一。
label.en: The whole galaxy will blaze in harmony.

tooltips.zh: 其他物种将试图反对我们。准备星系战争。
tooltips.en: Other species will try to oppose us. Prepare for Galactic war.

descriptions.zh:
星系熔炉现已全面武装并投入运行。随着虫洞通道完工，我们已取得通往围绕星系核心六个集结星系的通道。

我们开始进行核心过热工作。其它帝国可能察觉并试图进入这些恒星系，但暂时我们占有优势，核心已屈服于我们的意志。

§H使用虫洞保护星系核心恒星系§!
descriptions.en:
The Galactic Crucible is now fully armed and operational. With wormhole tunnels completed, we've secured access to all six staging systems around the Galactic Core.

Our work to overheat the Core can begin. Other empires may detect our activity and attempt to reach these systems, but for now, we hold the advantage, and the core bends to our will.

§HUse the wormhole to secure the Galactic Core systems§!

label.zh: 开始在核心恒星系中部署。
label.en: Begin installation in the core systems.

tooltips.zh: 在六个星系核心恒星系中部署§Y导管群§!，我们就能一次性使整个星系过热。必须着手准备。
tooltips.en: Deploying §YConduits§! in the six Galactic Core systems will let us overheat the entire galaxy at once. We must begin preparations.

label.zh: 我们的未来因火焰而光明。
label.en: Our future is bright with fire.

tooltips.zh: 在六个星系核心恒星系中部署§Y导管群§!，我们就能一次性使整个星系过热。必须着手准备。
tooltips.en: Deploying §YConduits§! in the six Galactic Core systems will let us overheat the entire galaxy at once. We must begin preparations.

descriptions.zh:
对立帝国已强行开启通往我们靠近星系核心集结地的超空间航路。随着我们持续使核心超热，必须为抵抗做好准备。

但我们不会被阻止。宇宙中寒冷黑暗将被驱散，取而代之的是我们崛起未来的炽热辉煌。
descriptions.en:
Rival empires have forced open hyperlanes to our staging grounds near the galactic core. As we continue to superheat the core, we must prepare for resistance.

But we will not be stopped. The cold dark of space will be scoured away, replaced by the blazing glory of our ascendant future.

label.zh: 他们永远无法扑灭我们。
label.en: They will never snuff us out.

options.script:
name = infernals.1035.a
trigger = { is_gestalt = no }

label.zh: 让他们前赴后继于熊熊烈焰中吧。
label.en: Let them hurl themselves into our incinerating blaze.

options.script:
name = infernals.1035.b
trigger = { is_gestalt = yes }

descriptions.zh:
星系核心开始躁动。环绕超大质量黑洞的熵水平激增，向附近恒星系释放出热辐射波动。

正当恐慌蔓延时，一支由多星球勇敢科学家组成的小组揭示了连接核心周边六个恒星系的新近超空间航路。这些恒星系据悉拥有由§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!运作的设施，正在积极使核心过热。这种鲁莽干预将引发星系级火风暴，将毁灭所有未能阻止纵火狂野心的人。

若想生存，我们必须突破这些恒星系，夺取控制权。危机已至——温度仍在攀升。
descriptions.en:
The galactic core has begun to stir. Entropy levels around the supermassive black hole are spiking, casting waves of thermal radiation into nearby systems.

Just as panic sets in, a team of brave scientists, drawn from many worlds, has unveiled newly-formed hyperlanes connecting to six systems encircling the core. These systems, it seems, house facilities operated by §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!, which are actively superheating the core. This reckless tampering threatens to ignite a cascading firestorm across the galaxy, incinerating all who fail to stop their pyromaniac ambitions.

If we wish to survive, we must breach these systems and wrest control from their grasp. The crisis is here—and the temperature is still rising.

tooltips.zh:
§L一场无与伦比的危机即将席卷我们的星系。唯有新成立联盟的联合力量才能拯救我们。§!

将组成反对危机的§Y联盟§!帝国，引发星系范围冲突。我们将§R对§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!宣战§!。
tooltips.en:
§LA crisis of unparalleled proportions is about to engulf our galaxy. Only the combined strength of a newly formed alliance can save us.§! 

Will form a §Ycoalition§! of empires opposing the crisis, resulting in a galaxy-wide conflict. We will §Rdeclare war§! against the §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!.

tooltips.zh: §L危机时刻，每个物种都应该自救。我们拥有独立解决的能力。§!
tooltips.en: §LIn times of crisis, it is every species for themselves. We have the strength to resolve this on our own.§!

tooltips.zh: §L§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!的方法符合我们新星系的愿景。契合于此，我们或可幸免于看似灾难的全力冲击。§!
tooltips.en: §LThe methods of §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! conform to our vision of a renewed galaxy. In light of this alignment, we may be spared the full force of what others will deem a catastrophe.§!

tooltips.zh: §L玩火的帝国司空见惯。此动荡终将过去，置身事外就好了。§!
tooltips.en: §LAn empire playing with fire is hardly a novelty. This upheaval will pass, as all things do. There is little reason to involve ourselves.§!

descriptions.zh:
历史上伟大变革常伴随牺牲。然而，星海共同体将我方的工作视为不必要的威胁，并以联合军事同盟名义对我们动员。

其目标直指灭绝，我们别无选择：任何接近星系核心或星系熔炉的行为都会遭到压倒性武力的回应。

我们的愿景已点燃恒星。让反对者迎战我们召唤的风暴吧。

§H守住星系核心恒星系，我们就一定能取得胜利！§!
descriptions.en:
History's greatest transformations have always demanded sacrifice. Yet the Galactic Community views our work as a threat rather than a necessity. In response, a unified military coalition has mobilized against us.

With extermination their stated goal, we are left with no alternative: any approach toward the Galactic Core or the Galactic Crucible will be met with overwhelming force.

Our vision has ignited the stars themselves. Let those who oppose it contend with the storm we have summoned.

§HDefend the Galactic Core systems and our victory is assured!§!

options.script: name = infernals.1042.a

descriptions.zh:
鉴于星系核心局势升级威胁，星海共同体联合采取行动反对§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!，其激进加热星系行为威胁所有已知生命。

若任其为所欲为，无数文明将陷灭绝危机。所谓§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!已与必要联合的联盟成直接对立。

战斗已发动，数万亿生命岌岌可危。

§H夺取星系核心恒星系，否则将失去一切！§!
descriptions.en:
In light of escalating threats at the galactic core, the Galactic Community has enacted a unified response against §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!, whose radical efforts to raise the galactic temperature endanger all known life.

Should these ambitions proceed unchecked, countless civilizations face extinction. The so-called §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! now stands in direct opposition to a coalition united by necessity.

The battle has begun, and trillions of lives hang in the balance.

§HCapture the Galactic Core systems or all will be lost!§!

options.script: name = infernals.1043.a

descriptions.zh:
火风暴即将爆发。星系核心将喷发，铲除敌人并确立我们对群星的统治。

然而星系拒绝接纳我们辉煌未来。通过新开超空间航路，他们密谋入侵集结地，颠覆我们的一切。目的何在？仅为守护那阴冷停滞的黑暗？

我们绝不能允许。必须坚守核心线，直至火风暴点燃，将他们化为灰烬。
descriptions.en:
A cascading firestorm impends. Soon, the galactic core will erupt, cleansing our enemies and cementing our dominion over the stars.

But the galaxy refuses to embrace our radiant future. Through the newly-forged hyperlanes, they plot to invade our staging grounds and undo everything we've built. For what? To preserve their cold, stagnant darkness?

We cannot allow them to interfere. We must hold the line at the core, until the firestorm ignites and reduces them to ash.

descriptions.zh:
星系核心持续升温，§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!的纵火狂热助推火势。按此速度，火风暴将消灭所有反对者，几乎灭绝星系所有生命。

不可沟通妥协。若想生存，必须攻破源头：星系核心恒星系，那里火力最旺。唯有如此，§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!方能阻止。

整个星系的命运悬于一线。是时候告诉§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!，玩火者……必将自食其果。
descriptions.en:
The galactic core grows ever hotter, driven by §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]'s§! fanatical obsession with igniting the stars. At this pace, their firestorm will annihilate all opposition, and purge the galaxy of nearly all life.

They cannot be reasoned with. If we are to survive, we must strike at the source: the Galactic Core systems, where their power burns brightest. Only then can §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! be stopped.

The fate of the entire galaxy hangs in the balance. It's time to show §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! that those who play with fire... will burn.

tooltips.zh: 必须控制六大核心恒星系才能获胜。
tooltips.en: We must maintain control of the six core systems to achieve victory.

tooltips.zh: 必须控制六大核心恒星系才能获胜。
tooltips.en: We must maintain control of the six core systems to achieve victory.

descriptions.zh:
随着§H[crucible_system.GetName]§!恒星系被占领，我们的军团夺取了那座环绕恒星建造的星系熔炉。

这座巨型建造物的沦陷，宣告了其缔造者以武力称霸星系的美梦破碎。
descriptions.en:
With the capture of the §H[crucible_system.GetName]§! system, our forces have also taken control of the Galactic Crucible that was being built around the local star. 

The loss of this megastructure shatters any remaining hope its creators had of taking over the galaxy by force.

tooltips.zh: §Y星系熔炉§!将被彻底毁坏，无法修复。
tooltips.en: The §YGalactic Crucible§! will be ruined beyond repair.

label.en: We can make use of this.

tooltips.zh: 将§Y星系熔炉§!转化为§Y星系熔炉研究院§!以生产£alloys£ §Y合金§!。
tooltips.en: Turns the §YGalactic Crucible§! into a §YGalactic Crucible Institute§! to produce £alloys£ §YAlloys§!.

descriptions.zh:
占领§H[crucible_system.GetName]§!系统揭露了§H[crucible_builders.GetName]§!的阴谋，他们企图通过前所未有的烈焰风暴彻底毁灭整个银河系。

目前，那台可能引发大规模灭绝的机器已被暂停。战争一旦结束，我们应动用剩余资源与兵力，将这座巨型建筑彻底摧毁。
descriptions.en:
Capturing the §H[crucible_system.GetName]§! system unveiled the sinister plans of the §H[crucible_builders.GetName]§!, which included the complete annihilation of the entire galaxy by an unprecedented storm of fire. 

For now, the machine that holds the potential to cause a mass extinction event has been put on hold. As soon as the war ends, we should use our remaining resources and strength to disable this giant megastructure once and for all.

label.zh: 我们必须尽快结束这场战争！
label.en: We have to end this war quickly!

options.script: name = infernals.1053.a

trigger:
is_triggered_only = yes
trigger = { from = { has_megastructure_flag = galactic_crucible@root } }

descriptions.zh:
从星系核心到最外围的恒星，我们煽起了胜利火焰。火风暴已将敌人烧成灰烬。他们缺乏勇气与远见，无法拥抱我们所缔造的辉煌未来。星系属于我们。

在这火与怒的新秩序里，行星被岩浆与光芒熔煮，由红巨星的火焰温度点亮。熵能涌流穿梭于每一恒星系，由我们采集、塑造。帝国日益富裕强盛……不可阻挡。

我们吞噬并重塑星系，成为虚空中熊熊燃烧的统治灯塔。或许有朝一日，我们还将引燃其他星系。
descriptions.en:
We have fanned the flames of victory from the galactic core to the outermost stars. The firestorm has reduced our enemies to ash. They lacked the vision, the courage, to embrace the glorious future we claimed. The galaxy is ours.

In this new order of fire and fury, planets boil with magma and light, set aglow by the swelling heat of red giants. Entropy surges through every system, ours to harvest and bend to our will. With each passing day, our empire grows richer, stronger... unstoppable.

We have consumed the galaxy and remade it as a blazing beacon of our dominion in the void. And one day, perhaps, we'll cast other galaxies onto the pyre.

label.zh: 这片新星系，我们志在必得。
label.en: This new galaxy is ours for the taking.

options.script:
name = infernals.1055.a
trigger = { is_gestalt = no }

label.zh: 终将所有火焰融为一体。
label.en: In the end, all fires join to become one.

options.script:
name = infernals.1055.b
trigger = { is_gestalt = yes }

label.zh: 我们的火热母星不容弱者拖累。
label.en: Our fiery home needs no tepid weaklings.

options.script:
name = infernals.1055.c
trigger = { is_genocidal_infernal = yes }

label.en: Our endurance has finally been rewarded.

options.script:
name = infernals.1055.d
trigger = { has_valid_civic = civic_pyrolatry }

label.zh: 终于，我们将寒冷与黑暗驱逐出星系。
label.en: At last, we've banished the cold dark from this galaxy.

label.zh: 最终，我们可怜的对手化为灰烬。
label.en: At last, our miserable rivals are reduced to ash.

descriptions.zh:
当我们忙于引燃星系时，§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!已经将其永久重塑，把恒星变为了武器。

现在，我们终于可以拥抱新的乌托邦，但随着他们对银河控制的加深，我们应密切监视他们的下一步行动。
descriptions.en:
While we were busy igniting the spark that would set the galaxy ablaze, the §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! had already transformed stars into weapons, reshaping the galaxy forever. 

For now, we can embrace this newly forged utopia, but we should closely monitor their next moves as they tighten their grip on the galaxy.

trigger = { is_gestalt = no }
